dispositions.claim: No transaction/rollback; PAY_KV writes external storage
dispositions.response: Rejected: transaction-only symbol is required; Wep3Ledger supplies PAY_KV adapter.put=staged.set, serializes the entire handler with blockConcurrencyWhile and commits its single storage.transaction only after a non-5xx response. Direct module use without this context is 503 before any KV read/write. Durable row failure regressions leave zero new records.

dispositions.claim: Idempotency and parent reads race without a lock/CAS
dispositions.response: Rejected: both reads and commit run inside the same singleton DO blockConcurrencyWhile. 20 concurrent same-key requests, 100 retries after restart, competing keys and whole-tree commit failures were executed, not inferred.

dispositions.claim: Canonical request hash must instead be a raw JSON byte hash
dispositions.response: Not a correctness defect: the idempotency digest intentionally binds normalized operation, parent, poster, amount micro-units, title and depth. Source file byte hashes and the minified review-representation hash are separately recorded. No raw-byte request-hash claim was made.

dispositions.claim: ASCII whitelist permits Unicode confusables or zero-width chars
dispositions.response: Rejected: anchored ASCII character classes exclude both; actual Request headers also enforce the HTTP value representation. No Unicode-normalization equivalence is used for keys.
